summary: Tested enter-town button clickability fix. Root cause found and fixed: background gradient overlay div inside TownPopup card (line 273) was intercepting pointer events. Added pointerEvents:'none' to fix it. Regular page.click() on enter-town-1 now navigates to /roadmap/1 successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: In TownPopup (Roadmap.js line 273), the absolute inset-0 background gradient div was missing pointerEvents:'none', causing it to intercept all click events on the Link button below it. Fixed by adding pointerEvents:'none' to the style.
